title: Golestan Tower of Silence, Yazd (west)
visualBrief: Specific standing western/northwestern Golestan dakhma at Yazd: separately mapped irregular broad ring with taller surviving roofless masonry and worn ocher plaster, genuinely open low eastern arched passage, projecting rectangular entrance landing and supported approach steps, gritty open court and smaller irregular recessed pit/broken lip/loose rubble. Four reused shared rubble/raw sandstone/stucco/gravel graphs. No intact historical tall tower, roof, bodies/bones, copied label/photo atlas, lower precinct buildings, eastern dakhma, complete hill or broad terrain slab.
